title: C7 root-level system-review verdict
description: Outcome of one opt-in root-level system review (S70 compliance-map / S60 data-flow-map / S10 threat-model / C8 architecture-review), run once at the root against the assembled tree (spec §3.2). Off by default; enabled via --with-*. The verdict folds into the final tree-gate.

verdict.description: clean = the system review found nothing gate-blocking. dirty = it found a blocking concern (the tree cannot be fully clean).

summary.description: Optional one-line summary of the review's finding, surfaced in the WorkflowReport's root-review table.
